instruction: humanize.natural_list() only works with lists. Accept any iterable, including tuples, dict key views, generators and ranges, producing the same output as for the equivalent list (for example natural_list(range(1, 4)) == '1, 2 and 3' and natural_list(('one',)) == 'one'), and update its type hints and docstring. Add tests.
instruction_source: written from the fix commit message, linked issue and hidden tests; describes behavior, not the change

excluded_tests.tests/test_benchmarks.py: performance benchmarks needing the pytest-codspeed benchmark fixture; not correctness tests
